second.name: Shoey Time! w/ Max and Danny

items.text: Cascadia Motorsport had a huge win to climb out of the relegation zone and into 7th place.
Cal Aggie Racing and Peloton Aubergine both had strong enough weeks to move into the promotion zone, even though they were playing each other.
XLIX Racing Team took the first half championship, finishing on 133 points.

Joe McGlynn.name: Joe McGlynn

stake.got: You beat Stalloni 1851.
stake.goal: for the chance to stay in the Championship Division for the second half
stake.condition: A win was enough on its own, and even a loss could have kept you up.

result.consequence: And that was enough to keep you in the Championship Division.
result.points: You earned 15 championship points to move to 104, which left you 4th in the Championship Division.
